title: Video Upscale: add H3 alongside LTX
description: The Upscale Video flow (ltx-upscale, MPI-584) is LTX-only. H3 now has a latent upscaler of its own (Comfyui_Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler, MinimaxH3LatentUpscaler3D), so the flow should accept an H3 clip too. Structurally parallel: ltx_video_upscale.json already works in LATENT space (LatentUpscaleModelLoader -> LTXVLatentUpsampler -> SamplerCustomAdvanced + ManualSigmas), and the H3 path is the same shape with MinimaxH3LatentUpscaler3D in the upsampler slot. Also sweep the flows that use H3: their graphs gain a generation pass + an upscale pass and DROP Input_Single_Pass, matching the LTX two-pass shape. Requested by the user 2026-09-04; separate from MPI-687, which is the node wrapper, not the Flow surface.
